statement: Under the Privacy Act 2020, an organisation or business whose privacy breach has caused, or is likely to cause, anyone serious harm must notify the Privacy Commissioner and any affected people as soon as it is practically able.
caveat: The notification duty is Privacy Act 2020 s 114, which the Commissioner's guidance frames within ss 112-117 (legislation.govt.nz answers automated fetches with an AWS WAF challenge, recorded 2026-10-23); the Commissioner's NotifyUs tool is the filing channel, and the guidance suggests notifying within 72 hours of becoming aware of a notifiable breach where possible. Check the live Office of the Privacy Commissioner guidance when assessing a breach.
